name: ken-markdown-editor
description: WYSIWYG Markdown editor: write rendered Markdown with slash commands, tables, Mermaid and draw.io diagrams, comments and frontmatter, themed by VS Code.

kenMarkdown.fontSize.markdownDescription: Base font size of body text, in pixels. Headings, code and lists scale from it.

kenMarkdown.bodyFontFamily.markdownDescription: CSS font stack for body text. `Hanken Grotesk` is bundled; any font installed on your system works too.

kenMarkdown.headingFontFamily.markdownDescription: CSS font stack for headings. `Newsreader` is bundled.

kenMarkdown.quoteFontFamily.markdownDescription: CSS font stack for block quotes, which are set in italics. Empty uses the heading font (`kenMarkdown.headingFontFamily`).

kenMarkdown.codeFontFamily.markdownDescription: CSS font stack for inline code and code blocks. `JetBrains Mono` is bundled.

kenMarkdown.lineHeight.markdownDescription: Line height of body text, as a multiple of the font size.

kenMarkdown.paragraphSpacing.markdownDescription: Space between paragraphs, as a multiple of the font size. List items are spaced by `#kenMarkdown.lineHeight#` instead.

kenMarkdown.headingSpacingBefore.markdownDescription: Space above headings, as a multiple of the font size. This is the space above a body-size heading (H6); larger headings get proportionally more, up to 1.35× for an H1. After a paragraph it replaces `#kenMarkdown.paragraphSpacing#` rather than adding to it. The first heading of the document is not moved.

kenMarkdown.headingSpacingAfter.markdownDescription: Space below headings, as a multiple of the font size. This is the space below a body-size heading (H6); it grows with the heading's size, so an H1 gets 2.25× as much.

kenMarkdown.maxWidth.markdownDescription: Maximum width of the text column, in pixels.

enumDescriptions: Both versions in one column: removed blocks in red, added in green.
The earlier version on the left and the current one on the right, scrolled together.
kenMarkdown.diff.layout.markdownDescription: How **Open Changes in Ken Markdown** shows a file's changes since the last commit. Either can be switched in the view itself.

enumDescriptions: Diffs of Markdown files (Source Control, Compare Selected, the Timeline) open rendered in the Ken Markdown diff view.
They open in VS Code's text diff editor; the Ken view is one click away in its title bar.
kenMarkdown.diff.openMarkdownDiffs.markdownDescription: Where diffs of two Markdown files open. The rendered view has a **Text diff** button for the source.

kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.enabled.markdownDescription: Show a grey number inline before each heading's text (`1`, `1.a`, `Section 1.01`…) and before each table of contents entry. Display only: numbers can't be selected, edited or copied, and are never written to the file. Headings inside quotes, alerts, lists and tables aren't numbered, and a skipped level (an H2 followed by an H4) is left out rather than shown as 0. Pick a style with `#kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.preset#`, or set each level with `#kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.h1#`…`#kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.h6#`. A document's own `ken-heading-numbering` property (`on`, `off`, a preset such as `legal`, or a format such as `"1.a.i"`) overrides these.

enumDescriptions: The per-level settings below (`h1`…`h6`, their parents and prefixes, and the separator).
1, 1.1, 1.1.1, then 1.1.1(a), 1.1.1(a)(i), 1.1.1(a)(i)(A): contracts citing the full path
Article I, Section 1.01, then 1.01(a), 1.01(a)(i), 1.01(a)(i)(A), 1.01(a)(i)(A)(1): US agreements citing the full path
kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.preset.markdownDescription: A ready-made numbering scheme. Any preset but `custom` overrides the per-level settings (`#kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.h1#`…`h6`, their `Parents` and `Prefix`, and `#kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.separator#`).

enumDescriptions: Not numbered, and left out of deeper headings' numbers.
kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.h1.markdownDescription: Number style for level 1 headings, when `#kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.preset#` is `custom`.

enumDescriptions: Parent numbers, then this level's: 1.a.i, or 1.01(a) before a parenthesized style.
Parent numbers, with plain letters and roman numerals (a, A, i, I) as digits, as Word's legal style numbering: Section 1.01 under Article I. Other parents keep their style: 1.01(a)(i).
Only this level's own label: (a) rather than 1.01(a).
kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.h1Parents.markdownDescription: Whether level 1 labels include the parent levels' numbers, when `#kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.preset#` is `custom`.

kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.h1Prefix.markdownDescription: Text before each level 1 label, such as `Article ` or `Section ` (include the trailing space). Not repeated in deeper labels. Used when `#kenMarkdown.headingNumbers.preset#` is `custom`.

enumDescriptions: Not numbered, and left out of deeper headings' numbers.

kenMarkdown.imageFolder.markdownDescription: Folder, next to the document, that pasted and dropped images are copied into (created when first needed). Leave empty to save images beside the document. Other files are always saved beside the document.

enumDescriptions: Link to files that are already in the workspace, where they are.
Copy them into the image folder (or beside the document), as for files from outside the workspace.
kenMarkdown.workspaceFiles.markdownDescription: What happens when you paste or drop a file that is already in the document's workspace folder (dragged from the Explorer, or from your file manager). `link` inserts a relative link to the file; `copy` saves a copy as for files from outside the workspace. Screenshots and other image data are always saved.

kenMarkdown.alwaysShowProperties.markdownDescription: Show the Properties (frontmatter) panel above every document, even one without frontmatter. Nothing is added to the file until you add a property.

kenMarkdown.commentAuthor.markdownDescription: Your name on comments you add. Empty uses git's `user.name`, else your OS account name.

enumDescriptions: Load each preview from lucid.app when it scrolls into view.
Show a card with a Load preview button; nothing loads from lucid.app until you click it.
No previews: Lucid links stay plain links.
kenMarkdown.lucidchart.preview.markdownDescription: Live previews of Lucidchart and Lucidspark links that are alone in their paragraph, loaded from `lucid.app`. Each preview has Edit and Open in Lucidchart buttons, which open your browser. Nothing is added to the file.

kenMarkdown.collaboration.port.markdownDescription: Port the collaboration hub listens on when you start a session. `0` picks a free port.

kenMarkdown.collaboration.allowNetwork.markdownDescription: Let people on your network join sessions you start (the hub listens on all interfaces instead of only this machine). Invites still carry a secret token. Not needed for Live Share, which forwards the port for you.
